one_liner: Issue and project tracking software for agile teams with robust developer resources and REST APIs.
auth_notes: Supports OAuth 2.0 (3LO), API tokens for basic auth, and Personal Access Tokens.
gate_notes: Free tier available for up to 10 users with self-serve signup.
verdict_reason: Jira provides a comprehensive public REST API and developer documentation, making it fully ready for building an AI integration toolkit.

extras.rate_limit_note: Rate limits apply based on Atlassian Cloud REST API policies.

evidence.quote: Jira brings teams together to reach the next level of productivity with AI ... Learn. Partners · Training & certification · Documentation · Developer resources.
